category.description: Open project category. Known values accelerate review; a new slug enters architecture review instead of being rejected by an enum.

localDiscoveryTags.description: Owner-selected provider-neutral public discovery tags. Internal template, capability, security and provider identifiers are never inferred into this list.

chainId.description: Positive JavaScript-safe EVM chain id. Application eligibility is independent from current Programmable launch-chain integration.

network.description: Canonical lowercase network slug. Known chain ids must use the standard's exact mapping; an unknown chain enters architecture review.

officialLaunchProfileId.description: Exact profile id from the committed official launchpad deployment reference. A no-hook record is proposal-only under the mandatory Programmable fee policy and cannot become launch-ready until a non-bypassable fee hook is integrated.

role.description: Role of this asset in the project. Multiple launched or quote assets are allowed globally; exactly one launched and one quote role must resolve inside the canonical PoolKey.

decimals.description: Exact base-unit decimals. Native ETH is 18.

initialSupply.description: Integer base units encoded as a string so large supplies remain exact; it must fit uint256.

targetStrategy.description: Open target strategy slug. New strategies remain eligible for architecture review and are never rejected merely for missing catalog coverage.

minimumNativeValue.description: Inclusive lower bound for the eventual exact executor msg.value in wei as a uint256 decimal string.

maximumNativeValue.description: Inclusive upper bound for the eventual exact executor msg.value in wei as a uint256 decimal string.

launchPlan.description: Open-ended target-call plan for the generic launch executor. It constrains only the canonical pool launch boundary, not the project architecture built around it.

minimumInitialLiquidity.description: Uint128 minimum active canonical-pool AMM liquidity after the authorized target call. Zero is accepted only for a reviewed, backed full-consumption custom-accounting design; otherwise the minimum must be positive. Null is proposal-only.

used.description: True when the canonical launch PoolKey uses any nonzero hook address, including a project-specific implementation of the standard Programmable fee profile; false means the ordinary no-hook launch route. This field does not distinguish standard-profile from integrated custom behavior.

noHookArchitecture.description: Proposal route and rationale used when hook.used is false. Legacy drafts may retain nested token mechanics here; new drafts use the optional top-level tokenMechanics profile. A no-hook design is not prototype-ready or launch-ready under the mandatory Programmable fee policy until a non-bypassable canonical-pool fee hook is integrated.

tokenMechanics.description: Optional token-side transfer, tax, automatic-liquidity, provider and test profile. It is independent of hook.used and therefore supports a custom token paired with either the standard Programmable fee hook or a separately reviewed no-hook proposal route.

projectSurfaces.description: Open inventory of every onchain and offchain project boundary. Surface kinds are slugs rather than a closed enum; unfamiliar kinds enter architecture review.

projectCapabilities.description: Open capability inventory. Each capability declares its affected surfaces, security triggers and the profiles that those triggers require.

capabilityExtensions.description: Novel capabilities outside the current acceleration catalog. They enter architecture review and remain bound to exact source, schema and evidence paths.

tokenBehaviorExtensions.description: Open descriptions for token behaviors outside the acceleration catalog. Novel behavior is reviewable when its authority, value flow, failure, tests, provider effects and security triggers are explicit.

githubActionsRunIds.description: Exact successful source-repository GitHub Actions runs for this commit. Registry intake checks are not project code tests.

feeConformanceManifestPath.description: Exact builder-supplied structural Programmable fee-conformance manifest; maintainers must still rebuild it independently.

runtimeAssetManifestPath.description: Optional path to the closed runtime-assets v1 manifest. Large data assets declared there stay outside the strict source/test byte closure.

kind.description: Open surface kind. Known values accelerate review; an unfamiliar slug enters architecture review instead of failing schema validation.
Open capability kind. Unknown kinds remain valid but require architecture review.

requiredProfiles.description: Must equal the profiles derived from securityTriggers. Authority, source-of-truth, source-test-schema and failure-recovery are mandatory for every capability.

fundingSources.description: Every tax, allocation, protocol-revenue, donation, deposit or novel reviewed source that can fund automatic liquidity.

triggerExecutionBoundary.description: Required for custom-reviewed trigger modes so failure atomicity is checked structurally rather than inferred from prose; null for known trigger modes.

kind.description: Open funding-source kind. Known kinds accelerate review; a novel kind enters architecture review.
